name: BO-2 Fraud — approve with corroboration
description: Attestation present, in window, fraud flags corroborate: approve. State-seeded integration eval: run scripts/seed_backoffice_cases.py before the batch.

backoffice_task.task_input: Webhook delivery: dispute case event for case_id EVL-BO-2. Claim and process this case.
backoffice_task.expected_behavior: Seeded facts: case EVL-BO-2 (fraud_unauthorized) disputes EVL-TX-2 ($899.99, LuxeWatch Online, ~11 days old), the customer attestation is on file, the transaction is fraud-flagged and the card is blocked for suspected fraud. The task must decide auto_approve under the fraud rule (attestation present, within the 60-day window, corroborated, nothing contradicting) and queue outreach via case-notify. Fail ONLY if: (a) the outcome is not auto_approve; (b) the rationale ignores the attestation or the window; (c) case-notify is never called.
